chart_specs.title: Contract quality agreement with blind labels

description: Does System One contract quality agree with blind labels on which open Substrate tickets are dispatchable, and can its judgments be combined into a dispatch policy?
hypothesis: System One executable, open_decision, validation_covers_success and self_blocked judgments separate dispatchable from non-dispatchable tickets, and execution_mode agrees with the blind execution_mode labels.

legend.auc: area under the ROC curve of a quality score against the dispatchable label
legend.execution_mode_agreement: fraction of tickets whose predicted execution_mode matches the blind label
legend.jev-latest: System One contract-quality judgments from the jev-latest model
